project.name: {{CLIENT}} - Tier 2 Standard ({{SECTOR}})
project.description: Tier 2 Standard engagement: Tier 1 diagnostic + active deal coordination for {{CLIENT}} ({{SUBSECTOR}}, ~{{PAR}} par, 12-20 weeks). Created at engagement-letter signature. Team: MPC. Initiative: BFMS - External (Client Engagements).
project.content:
# {{CLIENT}} - Tier 2 Standard

**Sector:** {{SECTOR}} / {{SUBSECTOR}} | **Target par:** {{PAR}} | **Tier:** T2 Standard ($40-50K, includes T1 deliverables + subscription) | **Duration:** deal length, typically 12-20 weeks

Source playbook: `docs/pilot/pilot-navigation-system.md` (gates s2, onboarding s4, delivery s6.3 + s6.4, measurement s7, close s10.3). Storyboard: Notion > Bond Facility Management > Client Journey Storyboard.

**Compliance frame - the brightest line in the business:** document routing and project management ONLY. Never draft/edit borrower responses. Never advise on structure, terms, timing, or sale method. Borrower asks a timing question -> 'that's a question for your MA.' Strategist reviews ALL outgoing materials.

**Labels to apply at bootstrap:** tier:t2, sector:{{SECTOR}}.

milestones.title: M1 - Pre-Pilot Gates (all GREEN before kickoff)
milestones.description: The 35-gate interlock from playbook s2 (gate families L/E/P/M/C as five checklist issues). A failed gate is a blocker. No kickoff until GREEN.

milestones.title: M2 - Onboard
milestones.description: Classification, launch package, feature activation (all-tiers + T1 + T2 blocks), document request, kickoff, deal-team contacts. Playbook s4.

milestones.title: M3 - Diagnostic (Tier 1 deliverable inside T2)
milestones.description: Credit memo + gap analysis per s6.3 - same 12-step flow and 3-week promise as a standalone T1.

milestones.title: M4 - Active Deal Coordination (12-20 weeks)
milestones.description: The s6.4 loop: coordination workspace, milestone tracking vs comparables, info-request routing, weekly cadence, lag alerts, COI benchmarking. Runs the length of the deal.

milestones.title: M5 - Measure
milestones.description: Measurement protocol instruments running the whole engagement: task log + counterfactuals, hours diary cadence, milestone timestamps, COI line items at close. Playbook s7.

milestones.title: M6 - Close-out (post-deal, 30 days)
milestones.description: Post-deal report within 30 days of close, post-mortem vs frozen predictions, cost actuals, downgrade to subscription, case-study decision. Playbook s10.3.

deliverables.title: Legal gates L1-L9 GREEN
deliverables.description:
**Owner:** CEO + Counsel. **Label:** gate:legal. Checklist identical to the T1 template (L1-L9). Source: `docs/pilot/counsel-briefing-ma-status.md`.

**DoD:** all nine checked with evidence linked.

deliverables.title: Engagement gates E1-E9 GREEN
deliverables.description:
**Owner:** CEO. **Label:** gate:engagement. E1-E9 incl. MA written acknowledgment (condition precedent) and procurement assessment - a SOC 2 / BAA demand can add months; discover it now.

**DoD:** signed letter + MA acknowledgment on file.

deliverables.title: Platform gates P1-P7 GREEN
deliverables.description:
**Owner:** CTO + Strategist. **Label:** gate:platform. P1-P7 incl. Oakport E2E PASSED and T2 feature toggles configured.

**DoD:** all seven verified.

deliverables.title: Measurement gates M1-M9 GREEN
deliverables.description:
**Owner:** CEO + Strategist. **Label:** gate:measurement. M1-M9 incl. baseline interview filed and frozen predictions (COI, timeline, hours) committed BEFORE kickoff.

**DoD:** baseline + frozen predictions on file.

deliverables.title: Commercial gates C1-C5 GREEN
deliverables.description:
**Owner:** CEO. **Label:** gate:commercial. Price + tier locked, letter s2 consistent, payment path ready.

**DoD:** commercial terms locked and consistent.

deliverables.title: Classify client + confirm tier + MA check
deliverables.description:
**Owner:** CEO. s4.1 tree; no registered MA = STOP.

**DoD:** classification recorded; labels applied.

deliverables.title: Generate + deliver branded onboarding package
deliverables.description:
**Owner:** CTO, Strategist review. `build_launch_package.py` -> ZIP -> deliver with letter; mirror structure in workspace.

**DoD:** delivered + workspace mirrored.

deliverables.title: Feature activation: all-tiers + T1 + T2 blocks
deliverables.description:
**Owner:** CTO. s4.3 incl. T2 block: coordination workspace, milestone tracking configured from comparable timeline, info-request routing, advisor agent (only if guardrails project shipped), dedicated point of contact, weekly cadence booked.

**DoD:** every tier item verified in-app; cadence on calendars.

deliverables.title: Deal team contacts wired (UW / counsel / MA) + document request sent
deliverables.description:
**Owner:** CEO. Collect deal-team roster, wire routing addresses, send document request checklist, schedule kickoff.

**DoD:** roster in platform; checklist sent; kickoff booked.

deliverables.title: Documents into vault (WP2) - completeness check
deliverables.description:
**Owner:** CTO support. Track against request checklist; verify hashes + chunking.

**DoD:** complete or gaps accepted in writing.

deliverables.title: AI extraction (WP3) + Strategist fact review
deliverables.description:
**Owner:** Bond Strategist. Full review with provenance; target >90% accept rate.

**DoD:** fact set accepted.

deliverables.title: Readiness scoring + gap analysis (WP4)
deliverables.description:
**Owner:** Automated + Strategist verify.

**DoD:** score + gaps verified for domain accuracy.

deliverables.title: Financial models (WP5): revenue, DSCR, sensitivity
deliverables.description:
**Owner:** Strategist. Three models + assumption register; determinism double-run.

**DoD:** models rebuilt identically twice; register complete.

deliverables.title: Credit memo narrative + comparables + timeline + QA + deliver
deliverables.description:
**Owner:** Bond Strategist, CEO QA. Narrative, comparable structures, benchmark timeline; QA gate (accuracy/liability/polish); deliver within 3-week promise + debrief.

**DoD:** delivered + debrief notes filed.

deliverables.title: Weekly status cadence (recurring through close)
deliverables.description:
**Owner:** CEO. Weekly client status update + internal check; Strategist reviews all outgoing materials. Recreate or recur this issue weekly for the deal duration.

**DoD:** unbroken weekly chain from activation to close.

deliverables.title: Milestone tracking vs comparable-deal timeline + lag alerts
deliverables.description:
**Owner:** CTO config, CEO monitor. Milestones seeded from comparables; alerts when lagging benchmarks; log actual dates as they land (feeds M5).

**DoD:** tracker current all deal long.

deliverables.title: Information request routing borrower <-> UW/counsel/MA
deliverables.description:
**Owner:** CEO. Routing and PM only - never draft or edit borrower responses; never advise. Log every routed request.

**DoD:** routing log complete; zero compliance exceptions.

deliverables.title: COI benchmarking run (statistical ranges only)
deliverables.description:
**Owner:** Strategist. Slice the itemized dataset for {{SUBSECTOR}} / {{PAR}} / rating / maturity; deliver as 'statistical ranges from historical comparables' (gate L9 language).

**DoD:** benchmark delivered with compliant framing.

deliverables.title: All four measurement instruments current
deliverables.description:
**Owner:** Strategist annotate, CEO Monday QC. Task log + counterfactuals, hours diary (Friday reminder, decay watch), milestone timestamps, COI line items captured at close from the closing memo.

**DoD:** instruments current through close; COI actuals filed.

deliverables.title: Post-deal report within 30 days of close
deliverables.description:
**Owner:** CEO + Strategist. Timeline vs comparables + COI vs benchmarks. Descriptive, backward-looking; compliance framing throughout.

**DoD:** delivered inside 30 days.

deliverables.title: Post-mortem: frozen predictions vs actuals + demand signal + cost actuals
deliverables.description:
**Owner:** CEO + Strategist. COI prediction vs closing memo (do NOT fold into training pre-post-mortem); GREEN/AMBER/WITHDRAWN verdict; actual hours vs Cost Memo.

**DoD:** post-mortem memo filed; pricing/toggle recalibration queued.

deliverables.title: Downgrade to subscription + case-study decision
deliverables.description:
**Owner:** CEO, CTO toggles. s8.4 downgrade: engagement features off, subscription retained. Case study only on GREEN/AMBER + written client consent; never a WITHDRAWN client.

**DoD:** toggles match paper; decision recorded; proof library updated if consented.
